name: Poisoned Apple
source:
With no past to remember, you live peacefully with your companions in the forest. But as beasts and nightmares emerge, how long can it truly last?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
你记不起自己的过去，和同伴们一起在森林里过着平静的生活。可当野兽和噩梦接连出现，这样的日子究竟还能持续多久？

［摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用[/url]］
